checksums.name: slot_sum16_read_validate
checksums.formula_detail: sum16(S[0x02:0x80]) == (u16_le(S[0x00:0x02]) + SEED_R) & 0xFFFF, where SEED_R=_DAT_0801fa9c (unresolved ROM constant, algebraically implied as 0x8BF1 from the one real sample). Also gated by u32_le(S[0x2C:0x30]) & MASK == EXPECTED (both constants unresolved).

checksums.name: slot_sum16_write_compute
checksums.formula_detail: new_checksum = (0x13 + sum16(S[0x02:0x80])) & 0xFFFF, stored at S[0x00:0x02]. Hard-coded seed literal 0x13 differs from the read-side solved SEED_R=0x8BF1; reconciliation is an open question (see report section 4.1).

io_driver_functions.notes: Raw DMA3 bit-serial transfer primitive to/from EEPROM data port 0x0D000000.
Sets busy/dispatch flag before EEPROM write busy-wait polling.
Clears busy/dispatch flag after EEPROM write completes.
eeprom_read_block(addr, buf[4]): reads one 8-byte EEPROM block via DMA3 bitstream.

eeprom_write_block(addr, buf[4]): writes one 8-byte EEPROM block with busy-wait. Called indirectly (via dispatch table) from 0x0801f72c; callgraph.json shows no static caller because the call is indirect.
eeprom_verify_block(addr, expect[4]): reads back and compares a written block. Called indirectly from 0x0801f72c.
Reads a full 128-byte slot (16 blocks) via 0x08020050.
Writes and verifies a full 128-byte slot (16 blocks) via 0x08020100/0x080201dc.
Per-slot checksum + magic validator; resets slot to hard-coded default on failure.

fields.name: slot_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Read-side validated as sum16(S[0x02:0x80]) == stored+SEED_R; write-side computed as (0x13+sum16(S[0x02:0x80]))&0xFFFF; default-reset path sets it to u16_le(S[0x2D]+S[0x2E]+0x76).
fields.evidence: ghidra/decompiled.c FUN_0801f9e4 (lines ~4015-4058) and FUN_0801fb74 (lines ~4143-4199); Python verification: stored=0x7a00, computed_sum=0x5f1, implied_seed=0x8bf1, self-consistent.

fields.name: slot_payload_block0
fields.update_mechanism: Flushed verbatim from RAM slot buffer to EEPROM block 0 by FUN_0801f72c; semantics of individual bytes not determined.
fields.evidence: Byte offsets 0x02-0x09 fall inside the checksum-covered range per FUN_0801f9e4 loop bounds; no further decompiled logic interprets this range.

fields.name: name_or_tag_field
fields.update_mechanism: Flushed verbatim with the rest of the slot; coincides with printable ASCII in the only real sample, distinct offset from the hard-coded default marker at 0x2D-0x2F.
fields.evidence: saves/hexdump_and_diffs.txt shows raw bytes 63 6d 6b at absolute offset 0x28; no decompiled code specifically interprets this offset as text, so semantics are inferred from byte pattern only.

fields.name: magic_version_gate
fields.update_mechanism: Read and masked: (u32_le(S[0x2C:0x30]) & MASK) == EXPECTED. MASK/EXPECTED constants (_DAT_0801faa0/_DAT_0801faa4) not resolved from this trace-limited decompilation.

fields.name: default_marker_byte_2d
fields.update_mechanism: Set to 0x6B ('k') unconditionally on checksum/magic validation failure as part of the default-record reset.

fields.name: default_marker_byte_2e
fields.update_mechanism: Set to 0x6D ('m') unconditionally on checksum/magic validation failure.

fields.name: default_marker_byte_2f
fields.update_mechanism: Set to 0x63 ('c') unconditionally on checksum/magic validation failure. Not included in the default-path checksum recomputation (open question, see report 4.1).

fields.name: slot_payload_tail_unused

fields.evidence: saves/hexdump_and_diffs.txt bytes 0x30-0x7F are all 0x00 for cap-01-future-1.sav.

fields.name: slot_1_2_3_payload

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If a record-valid flag, the associated value is treated as absent/default; if part of a wider numeric field, a large numeric swing is observed.

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Load should still succeed with nonzero tail bytes if this range is genuinely inert padding; any crash/misbehavior disproves that.

open_questions: Exact numeric value of the read-side checksum seed constant _DAT_0801fa9c (algebraically implied as 0x8BF1 from the single real sample, unverified against a second independent sample).

Reconciliation between the write-side hard-coded seed literal 0x13 (FUN_0801fb74) and the read-side solved seed 0x8BF1 -- these do not algebraically agree when applied to the hard-coded default-reset state; needs a .ss capture immediately after a forced factory reset to resolve.
Concrete mask/expected values for the secondary magic/version gate at offset 0x2C-0x2F (_DAT_0801faa0 / _DAT_0801faa4), not present in this trace-guided decompilation.

Gameplay semantics of the per-block payload bytes (offsets 0x02-0x27) and the 3-byte field at 0x28-0x2A -- currently inferred only from byte-pattern/ASCII observation, not from any label or trace correlation to on-screen state.
Whether slots 1-3 are genuinely independent records (e.g. multiple save profiles / leaderboard entries) or reserved/unused space -- never observed non-blank in this corpus.

All RAM mirror base addresses (_DAT_0801fa90, _DAT_0801f7e8, _DAT_0801f6e8, etc.) resolve to ROM-resident pointer variables whose runtime values are not present in this trace-guided decompilation; true EWRAM/IWRAM addresses are unknown.

Whether the default-reset state (checksum 4E 01, payload mostly zero with 'k'/'m'/'c' at 0x2D-0x2F) is itself expected to pass or fail its own next validation pass -- the algebra suggests it fails again (self-healing idempotent reset), but this is unconfirmed by direct observation.
